contentText: The Netherlands and Japan clash in a decisive Group stage encounter that will shape both teams' knockout ambitions. Japan arrive in fine form with five consecutive victories, while the Dutch face a more uncertain path. With Sweden and Tunisia also competing for places, this fixture in the tournament's toughest group carries enormous weight and every point counts in the battle for progression. Follow our liveblog.
